rule_or_requirement: Local candidates must finish the qualified line on at least as many matched cells as the selected control before a faster lap can justify advancement.
observable_information: At inference only four grayscale frames and base pixel-controller actions; at evaluation, actual finish time, progress, collision and damage telemetry, per-step action and speed, and runtime limits.
allowed_action_or_state_change: The frozen launch ZIP may raise gas to 0.45 on the opening clear straight for at most 18 decisions, permanently returning to selected full-road-guard control at the first registered exit signal; no code, ZIP, or threshold changes during comparison.
expected_success_endpoint: Candidate finish count no lower than control on twelve untouched held-out cells and, on a completion tie, shorter median finished lap time. Initial speed and public top-three gap are diagnostic only.
control: Selected full-road-guard ZIP SHA-256 5c55670ab5aef4bf64115909792650a5e76bc3576a64f3aaeb3780efabc18e40 on exactly the same registered cells.
falsifier: Candidate-only nonfinish, lower aggregate completion, invalid action or resource-limit violation; on a completion tie, no shorter median finished lap; zero launch activation or no first-10-percent change weakens the proposed causal mechanism.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Run unchanged exact ZIPs in alternating order on tracks 1-3 times untouched seeds 2904-2907, twelve paired cells and twenty-four episodes, with a 2000-decision cap.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered local Linux Python 3.11 CPU profile, 2 CPUs, 2 GiB, 1800 seconds; preserve all episodes in V2 roots. No held-out/confirmation or official site action in this run.
